title: Name the reason a solve was refused
heading: A Refusal Is Raised as an AttributeError in OR-Tools 9.15, and Its Reason Is on __context__
cases: a refused HiGHS thread count gives ('INVALID_ARGUMENT', the solver's message without the bracketed code)
an integer model sent to GLOP gives ('INVALID_ARGUMENT', 'Glop does not support integer variables')
a quadratic objective sent to HiGHS gives the code 'UNIMPLEMENTED'
a ValueError ending in '(was C++ INVALID_ARGUMENT)' gives that code and the message before the suffix
a RuntimeError or an AttributeError with no hidden status gives ('UNKNOWN', its own message)
